articles.title_en: Natural disasters as macroeconomic tail risks
articles.title_cn: 自然灾害作为宏观经济尾部风险
articles.abstract_en: We introduce quantile and moment impulse response functions for structural quantile vector autoregressive models. We use them to study how climate-related natural disasters affect the predictive distribution of output growth and inflation. Disasters strongly shift the forecast distribution particularly in the tails. They result in an initial sharp increase of the downside risk for growth, followed by a temporary rebound. Upside risk to inflation increases markedly for a few months and then subsides. As a result, natural disasters have a persistent impact on the conditional variance and skewness of macroeconomic aggregates which standard linear models estimating conditional mean dynamics fail to match. We perform a scenario analysis to evaluate the hypothetical effects of more frequent large disasters on the macroeconomy due to increased atmospheric carbon concentration. Our results indicate a substantially higher conditional volatility of growth and inflation as well as increased upside risk to inflation particularly in a scenario where only currently pledged climate policies are implemented.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了结构分位数向量自回归模型的分位数和矩脉冲响应函数。我们利用它们来研究气候相关自然灾害如何影响产出增长和通胀的预测分布。灾害强烈地改变了预测分布，尤其是在尾部。它们导致增长的下行风险最初急剧增加，随后出现暂时反弹。通胀的上行风险在几个月内显著增加，然后消退。因此，自然灾害对宏观经济总量的条件方差和偏度产生了持续影响，而估计条件均值动态的标准线性模型无法匹配这一点。我们进行了情景分析，以评估由于大气碳浓度增加而导致更频繁的大灾害对宏观经济的假设性影响。我们的结果表明，增长和通胀的条件波动性显著提高，通胀上行风险增加，特别是在仅实施当前承诺的气候政策的情景下。

articles.title_en: Bootstrapping out-of-sample predictability tests with real-time data
articles.title_cn: 基于实时数据的样本外可预测性检验的引导方法
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we develop a block bootstrap approach to out-of-sample inference when real-time data are used to produce forecasts. In particular, we establish its first-order asymptotic validity for West-type (1996) tests of predictive ability in the presence of regular data revisions. This allows the user to conduct asymptotically valid inference without having to estimate the asymptotic variances derived in Clark and McCracken’s (2009) extension of West (1996) when data are subject to revision. Monte Carlo experiments indicate that the bootstrap can provide satisfactory finite sample size and power even in modest sample sizes. We conclude with an application to inflation forecasting that revisits the results in Ang et al. (2007) in the presence of real-time data.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一种块引导方法，用于在使用实时数据生成预测时进行样本外推断。具体而言，我们在存在常规数据修订的情况下，建立了该方法对West型（1996）预测能力检验的一阶渐近有效性。这使得用户无需估计Clark和McCracken（2009）对West（1996）扩展中推导的渐近方差，即可进行渐近有效的推断。蒙特卡洛实验表明，即使在样本量较小的情况下，引导方法也能提供令人满意的有限样本规模和功效。最后，我们将其应用于通货膨胀预测，并在实时数据存在的情况下重新审视了Ang等人（2007）的结果。

articles.title_en: Modelling large dimensional datasets with Markov switching factor models
articles.title_cn: 马尔可夫切换因子模型对高维数据集建模
articles.abstract_en: We study a novel large dimensional approximate factor model with regime changes in the loadings driven by a latent first order Markov process. By exploiting the equivalent linear representation of the model, we first recover the latent factors by means of Principal Component Analysis. We then cast the model in state–space form, and we estimate loadings and transition probabilities through an EM algorithm based on a modified version of the Baum–Lindgren–Hamilton–Kim filter and smoother that makes use of the factors previously estimated. Our approach is appealing as it provides closed form expressions for all estimators. More importantly, it does not require knowledge of the true number of factors. We derive the theoretical properties of the proposed estimation procedure, and we show their good finite sample performance through a comprehensive set of Monte Carlo experiments. The empirical usefulness of our approach is illustrated through three applications to large U.S. datasets of stock returns, macroeconomic variables, and inflation indexes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种新颖的大维近似因子模型，其中载荷的体制变化由潜在的一阶马尔可夫过程驱动。通过利用模型的等价线性表示，我们首先通过主成分分析恢复潜在因子。然后，我们将模型置于状态空间形式，并通过基于修改版的Baum-Lindgren-Hamilton-Kim滤波和平滑算法的EM算法估计载荷和转移概率，该算法利用了先前估计的因子。我们的方法具有吸引力，因为它为所有估计量提供了闭式表达式。更重要的是，它不需要知道真实因子的数量。我们推导了所提出估计过程的理论性质，并通过一系列全面的蒙特卡洛实验展示了其良好的有限样本性能。我们方法的实证效用通过三个应用于美国大型股票收益、宏观经济变量和通胀指数数据集的例子加以说明。

articles.title_en: On testing for spatial or social network dependence in panel data allowing for network variability
articles.title_cn: 考虑网络可变性的面板数据中的空间或社交网络依赖性测试
articles.abstract_en: The paper introduces robust generalized Moran I tests for network-generated cross-sectional dependence in a panel data setting where unit-specific effects can be random or fixed. Network dependence may originate from endogenous variables, exogenous variables, and/or disturbances, and the network dependence is allowed to vary over time. The formulation of the test statistics also aims at accommodating situations where the researcher is unsure about the exact nature of the network. Unit-specific effects are eliminated using the Helmert transformation, which is well known to yield time-orthogonality for linear forms of transformed disturbances. Given the specification of our test statistics, these orthogonality properties also extend to the quadratic forms that underlie our test statistics. This greatly simplifies the expressions for the asymptotic variances of our test statistics and their estimation. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the generalized Moran I tests introduced in this paper have the proper size and can provide substantial improvement in robustness when the researcher faces uncertainty about the specification of the network topology.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了在面板数据设置中网络生成的横截面依赖性的稳健广义 Moran I 检验，其中单位特定效应可以是随机的或固定的。网络依赖性可能源于内生变量、外生变量和/或干扰，并且允许网络依赖性随时间变化。测试统计数据的制定还旨在适应研究人员不确定网络的确切性质的情况。使用赫尔默特变换可以消除单位特定的影响，众所周知，赫尔默特变换可以为变换扰动的线性形式产生时间正交性。考虑到我们的测试统计数据的规范，这些正交性属性也扩展到我们测试统计数据基础的二次形式。这极大地简化了我们的检验统计量及其估计的渐近方差的表达式。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，本文引入的广义 Moran I 测试具有适当的规模，并且当研究人员面临网络拓扑规范的不确定性时，可以在鲁棒性方面提供实质性改进。

articles.title_en: Individual welfare analysis: Random quasilinear utility, independence, and confidence bounds
articles.title_cn: 个体福利分析：随机拟线性效用、独立性与置信界
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a novel framework for individual-level welfare analysis. It builds on a parametric model for continuous demand with a quasilinear utility function, allowing for heterogeneous coefficients and unobserved individual-good-level preference shocks. We obtain bounds on the individual-level consumer welfare loss at any confidence level due to a hypothetical price increase, solving a scalable optimization problem constrained by a novel confidence set under an independence restriction. This confidence set is computationally simple and robust to weak instruments, nonlinearity, and partial identification. The validity of the confidence set is guaranteed by our new results on the joint limiting distribution of the independence test by Chatterjee (2021). These results together with the confidence set may have applications beyond welfare analysis. Monte Carlo simulations and two empirical applications on gasoline and food demand demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个新颖的个体层面福利分析框架。该框架基于连续需求与拟线性效用函数的参数模型，允许异质性系数以及未被观测到的个体-商品层面偏好冲击。我们在任意置信水平下，针对假设的价格上涨，获得了个体层面消费者福利损失的界，通过求解一个由独立性约束下的新颖置信集所限制的可扩展优化问题。该置信集计算简单，且对弱工具变量、非线性和部分识别具有稳健性。置信集的有效性由我们关于Chatterjee（2021）独立性检验的联合极限分布的新结果所保证。这些结果连同置信集可能在福利分析之外还有其他应用。蒙特卡洛模拟以及关于汽油和食品需求的两个实证应用证明了我们方法的有效性。

articles.title_en: Inference on dynamic systemic risk measures
articles.title_cn: 动态系统性风险测度的推断
articles.abstract_en: Systemic risk measures (SRM) quantify the risk of a system induced by the possible distress of any of its components. Applications in economics and finance are numerous. We define a general dynamic framework for the risk factors, allowing us to obtain explicit expressions of the corresponding dynamic SRM. We deduce an easy-to-implement statistical approach which, based on semi-parametric assumptions, reduces to estimating univariate location-scale models and to computing (static) quantiles of the residuals. We derive a sound asymptotic theory (including confidence intervals, tests, validity of a residual bootstrap) for major SRM, namely the Conditional VaR (CoVaR) and Delta-CoVaR. Our theoretical results are illustrated via Monte-Carlo experiments and real financial and macroeconomic time series.
articles.abstract_cn: 系统性风险测度（SRM）量化了系统因任一组成部分可能陷入困境而引发的风险。在经济学和金融学中的应用众多。我们为风险因素定义了一个一般性的动态框架，从而能够获得相应动态SRM的显式表达式。我们推导出一种易于实施的统计方法，该方法基于半参数假设，简化为估计单变量位置-尺度模型并计算残差的（静态）分位数。我们为主要SRM，即条件VaR（CoVaR）和Delta-CoVaR，建立了健全的渐近理论（包括置信区间、检验、残差自举法的有效性）。我们的理论结果通过蒙特卡洛实验以及真实的金融和宏观经济时间序列得到了验证。

articles.title_cn: 周期自回归的收缩估计量
articles.abstract_en: A periodic autoregression [PAR] is a seasonal time series model where the autoregressive parameters vary over the seasons. A drawback of PAR models is that the number of parameters increases dramatically when the number of seasons gets large. Hence, one needs many periods with intra-seasonal data to be able to get reliable parameter estimates. Therefore, these models are rarely applied for weekly or daily observations. In this paper we propose shrinkage estimators which shrink the periodic autoregressive parameters to a common value determined by the data. We derive the asymptotic properties of these estimators in case of a quadratic penalty and we illustrate the bias–variance trade-off. Empirical illustrations show that shrinkage improves forecasting with PAR models.
articles.abstract_cn: 周期自回归[PAR]是一种季节性时间序列模型，其中自回归参数随季节变化。PAR模型的一个缺点是，当季节数量增多时，参数数量急剧增加。因此，需要许多包含季节内数据的周期才能获得可靠的参数估计。因此，这些模型很少应用于周度或日度观测数据。在本文中，我们提出了收缩估计量，将周期自回归参数收缩到由数据确定的共同值。我们推导了在二次惩罚情况下这些估计量的渐近性质，并说明了偏差-方差的权衡。实证示例表明，收缩改善了PAR模型的预测。

articles.title_en: Bond risk premiums at the zero lower bound
articles.title_cn: 零利率下限下的债券风险溢价
articles.abstract_en: We document that the spread between long- and short-term government bond yields is a stronger predictor of excess bond returns when the U.S. economy is at the zero lower bound (ZLB) than away from this bound. The Gaussian shadow rate model with a linear or quadratic shadow rate is unable to explain this change in return predictability. The same holds for the quadratic term structure model and the autoregressive gamma-zero model that also enforce the ZLB. In contrast, the linear-rational square-root model explains our new empirical finding because the model allows for unspanned stochastic volatility as seen in bond yields.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了当美国经济处于零利率下限（ZLB）时，长期与短期政府债券收益率之间的利差对超额债券收益的预测能力比远离该下限时更强。具有线性或二次影子利率的高斯影子利率模型无法解释这种收益可预测性的变化。同样，二次期限结构模型和自回归伽马零模型也无法解释，这些模型也强制执行零利率下限。相比之下，线性有理平方根模型解释了我们的新实证发现，因为该模型允许如债券收益率中所见的非跨越随机波动性。

articles.title_en: Uniform inference for cointegrated vector autoregressive processes
articles.title_cn: 协整向量自回归过程的均匀推断
articles.abstract_en: Uniformly valid inference for cointegrated vector autoregressive processes has so far proven difficult due to certain discontinuities arising in the asymptotic distribution of the least squares estimator. We extend asymptotic results from the univariate case to multiple dimensions and show how inference can be based on these results. Furthermore, we show that lag augmentation and a recent instrumental variable procedure can also yield uniformly valid tests and confidence regions. We verify the theoretical findings and investigate finite sample properties in simulation experiments for two specific examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于最小二乘估计量的渐近分布中存在某些不连续性，协整向量自回归过程的均匀有效推断迄今难以实现。我们将单变量情形下的渐近结果扩展到多维度，并展示如何基于这些结果进行推断。此外，我们证明滞后增广和一种近期的工具变量方法也能产生均匀有效的检验和置信区域。我们通过两个具体例子的模拟实验验证了理论发现，并研究了有限样本性质。

articles.title_en: Iterative estimation of nonparametric regressions with continuous endogenous variables and discrete instruments
articles.title_cn: 具有连续内生变量和离散工具变量的非参数回归的迭代估计
articles.abstract_en: We consider a nonparametric regression model with continuous endogenous independent variables when only discrete instruments are available that are independent of the error term. Although this framework is very relevant for applied research, its implementation is challenging, as the regression function becomes the solution to a nonlinear integral equation. We propose a simple iterative procedure to estimate such models and showcase some of its asymptotic properties. In a simulation experiment, we detail its implementation in the case when the instrumental variable is binary. We conclude with an empirical application to returns to education.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个非参数回归模型，其中包含连续的内生自变量，且仅有与误差项独立的离散工具变量可用。尽管这一框架对应用研究非常相关，但其实现具有挑战性，因为回归函数成为非线性积分方程的解。我们提出了一种简单的迭代程序来估计此类模型，并展示了其一些渐近性质。在模拟实验中，我们详细说明了在工具变量为二元情况下的实现。最后，我们将其应用于教育回报的实证研究。

articles.title_en: The robust F-statistic as a test for weak instruments
articles.title_cn: 稳健F统计量作为弱工具变量的检验
articles.abstract_en: For the linear model with a single endogenous variable, (Montiel Olea and Pflueger 2013) proposed the effective F-statistic as a test for weak instruments in terms of the Nagar bias of the two-stage least squares (2SLS) or limited information maximum likelihood (LIML) estimator relative to a benchmark worst-case bias. We show that their methodology for the 2SLS estimator applies to a class of linear generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators with an associated class of generalized effective F-statistics. The standard robust F-statistic is a member of this class. The associated GMMf estimator, with the extension “f” for first-stage, has the weight matrix based on the first-stage residuals. In the grouped-data IV designs of Andrews (2018) with moderate and high levels of endogeneity and where the robust F-statistic is large but the effective F-statistic is small, the GMMf estimator is shown to behave much better in terms of bias than the 2SLS estimator.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于具有单一内生变量的线性模型，(Montiel Olea和Pflueger 2013)提出了有效F统计量，作为基于两阶段最小二乘(2SLS)或有限信息最大似然(LIML)估计量相对于基准最坏情况偏差的Nagar偏差的弱工具变量检验。我们表明，他们针对2SLS估计量的方法适用于一类线性广义矩方法(GMM)估计量，并伴随一类广义有效F统计量。标准稳健F统计量属于此类。相关的GMMf估计量，其中扩展“f”表示第一阶段，其权重矩阵基于第一阶段残差。在Andrews (2018)的分组数据IV设计中，当内生性程度中等或较高，且稳健F统计量较大但有效F统计量较小时，GMMf估计量在偏差方面表现出比2SLS估计量更好的行为。

articles.title_en: Simulation error and numerical instability in estimating random coefficient logit demand models
articles.title_cn: 估计随机系数Logit需求模型中的模拟误差与数值不稳定性
articles.abstract_en: The nonlinear GMM-IV estimator of Berry, Levinsohn and Pakes (1995) can suffer from numerical instability resulting in a wide range of parameter estimates and economic implications. This has been reported to depend on technical details such as the choice of the optimization algorithm, starting values, and convergence criteria. We show that numerical approximation errors in the estimator’s moment function are the main driver of this instability. With accurate approximation, the estimation approach is well-behaved. We provide a simple method to determine the required number of simulation draws.
articles.abstract_cn: Berry、Levinsohn和Pakes（1995）的非线性GMM-IV估计器可能遭受数值不稳定性，导致参数估计和经济含义的范围广泛。据报道，这取决于技术细节，如优化算法的选择、起始值和收敛标准。我们表明，估计器矩函数中的数值近似误差是这种不稳定性的主要驱动因素。通过精确近似，估计方法表现良好。我们提供了一种简单的方法来确定所需的模拟抽取次数。
